items.headline: Del Rio-Wilson leads Marshall rally in 28-27 win over Georgia State to become bowl eligible
items.description: — Carlos Del Rio-Wilson threw for 199 yards and three touchdowns and Marshall overcame a late rally to beat Georgia State 28-27 and become bowl eligible on Saturday.

items.headline: Georgia Southern keeps Georgia State out of end zone in the 2nd half for 34-17 win
items.description: — Max Johnson threw two touchdown passes for Georgia Southern, and the Eagles kept Georgia State out of the end zone in the second half for a 34-17 victory on Saturday.
